title: Data Analyst
description: Data Analyst collects, organises and analyses data to generate insights that support organisational decision-making and performance management. They import, clean, validate and transform data from multiple sources, develop appropriate data models, and ensure the accuracy, consistency and reliability of data repositories. The role involves interpreting results, producing reports and visualisations, and communicating findings to stakeholders in line with business objectives.

tasks.text: Extract, clean, and integrate raw data from multiple sources.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Enrich data to build comprehensive datasets.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Perform data quality checks and validation.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Perform statistical and exploratory analysis to identify trends and patterns.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Develop reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Prepare documentation of data sources, analytical methods, and models to ensure transparency and reproducibility.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Present analytical findings to management and stakeholders.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Collaborate with teams to define data requirements and ensure data accuracy.
tasks.label: human_led

title: Database Assistant
description: Database Assistant supports the management and maintenance of an organisation’s structured databases, ensuring data is accurate, accessible, and secure. They perform tasks such as data entry, cleaning, retrieval, and basic analysis, and assist with administrative duties related to record keeping. This role provides foundational support within data management or IT departments.

tasks.text: Enter, update, and verify database records.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Maintain data integrity and ensure accuracy of records.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Generate reports and assist in data extraction for audits or management purposes.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Back up databases and monitor for errors or inconsistencies.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Assist database administrators with routine maintenance and simple system administration tasks.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Assist in maintaining data security and compliance with organisational standards.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Business Intelligence Analyst studies industry trends and organisational operations to identify opportunities for improvement, particularly in processes, supply chains, and sales. They gather, analyse, and visualise data to produce actionable insights that inform strategic planning, define key performance indicators, and guide decision-making. Their work includes assessing and optimising business processes, developing dashboards and reports, and ensuring data collection and operational systems are accurate, reliable, and aligned with organisational objectives.

tasks.text: Collect, analyse, and visualise data from multiple sources to support business decisions.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using business intelligence (BI) and visualisation tools.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Identify trends, patterns, and insights to inform business strategy.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Analyse business processes and workflows, and design improvements aligned with business goals.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Collaborate with information technology (IT) and business teams to define requirements and support process integration.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Automate recurring data collection and reporting processes to improve efficiency and reliability.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and other performance metrics to evaluate process and workflow effectiveness.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Document processes, prepare visual diagrams, and provide support for process updates.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

title: Computer Network Technician
description: Computer Network Technician is responsible for the installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of an organisation’s network infrastructure. They ensure network security, monitor performance, optimise system capacity, and resolve connectivity issues to support continuous and efficient operations. The role involves working with hardware and software components, assisting IT teams, and implementing upgrades and security measures to maintain reliable and secure network services.

tasks.text: Design, install, and maintain local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), and related systems, including documentation, inventory management, and system upgrades.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Monitor network performance, troubleshoot connectivity, hardware, and software issues, and implement optimisations.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Install, configure, and upgrade network hardware, software, and cabling.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Implement and maintain network security measures.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Provide technical support and guidance to users on network-related issues.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Collaborate with Information Technology (IT) teams and network architects on network deployments, migrations, and optimisations.
tasks.label: human_led

title: Digital Learning Specialist
description: Digital Learning Specialist designs, develops, and implements online learning programs, creating multimedia content and interactive modules to enhance learner engagement. They manage the technical setup, delivery, and monitoring of digital courses to ensure effective and impactful learning experiences.

tasks.text: Develop, curate, and maintain multimedia and interactive digital learning content using e-learning software and audio-visual elements to enhance learner engagement.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Design and implement digital learning programmes, including online courses, assessments, and e-learning modules.

tasks.text: Collaborate with subject matter experts and instructional designers to ensure the accuracy, quality, and engagement of digital learning content.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Provide training and technical support to educators on digital tools, instructional technologies, and the effective use of educational technology.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Manage the technical setup, delivery, version control, content updates, and storage of digital learning materials and courses.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Monitor, evaluate, and improve the effectiveness and impact of digital learning programmes and courses.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Cybersecurity Analyst roles involve protecting an organisation’s computer systems, networks, and data from cyber threats by identifying vulnerabilities, monitoring security systems, and responding to incidents. They develop, implement, and maintain IT governance, risk, and compliance policies and frameworks, conduct risk assessments and audits, and design measures to safeguard sensitive information while supporting disaster recovery and overall information security strategies.

tasks.text: Support the development and implementation of cybersecurity policies, procedures, and controls.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Monitor and analyse network traffic and Information Technology (IT) systems to detect, assess, and respond to security threats.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities through vulnerability assessments and analysis.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

tasks.text: Investigate cybersecurity incidents and breaches to determine causes and impacts.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Manage and utilise security tools and systems to support threat detection and prevention.

tasks.text: Collaborate with IT teams to support secure system operations and cybersecurity initiatives.

tasks.text: Maintain and update security documentation, compliance records, and operational reports.
tasks.label: automatable

tasks.text: Analyse threat intelligence and stay informed on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and best practices.
tasks.label: ai_assisted

title: Solar Cell Technician
description: Solar Cell Technician operates, monitors, and maintains solar energy systems, including assembling, installing, testing, and servicing solar photovoltaic (PV) cells and panels. They ensure systems perform efficiently by inspecting equipment, troubleshooting faults, and carrying out repairs or replacements, working in manufacturing settings or on-site installations for residential, commercial, or industrial projects to support the generation and maintenance of sustainable energy.

tasks.text: Assemble and test solar cells, modules, and panels to ensure quality and optimal performance.
tasks.label: human_led

tasks.text: Install solar photovoltaic (PV) systems safely and accurately at designated sites.

tasks.text: Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues in solar PV systems.
